description.value: Triple-O's is a BC-born premium quick-service burger chain and sibling brand to White Spot, with roots tracing back to 1928 and now spanning 70 locations across BC, Alberta, and Ontario. This South Vancouver outpost is co-located with a Chevron gas station on Southeast Marine Drive and offers drive-thru service alongside takeout and delivery. The menu centres on fresh Canadian beef burgers with the chain's signature Triple 'O' sauce, hand-scooped milkshakes, and thick-cut Kennebec fries.
